name: Fuchsgrub
beschreibung:
Idyllisch nestled in the village of Ebbs, renowned for Haflinger horses and flowers, Landhaus Fuchsgrub welcomes guests with cosy rooms and apartments. It is an ideal starting point for discovering the lower Inn valley.

The Fohlenhof stud farm, the Zahmer Kaiser peaks, and the fortress town of Kufstein are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Landhaus Fuchsgrub in Ebbs offers charming accommodation in the scenic Kufsteinerland region.
